topic: Need for simple oxygen system and pressurized cabin effect of lack of o2, Types of 02 regulators
syllabus_extract: Need for simple oxygen system and pressurized cabin effect of lack of o2, Types of 02 regulators. Fire detection and protection system:
specific_objectives: 17.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the need of oxygen systems, types of systems, working principles of components.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of regulator operation principles; Safety: Do not breathe directly from regulator; Instructor supervision required
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft oxygen system?
How does cabin pressure affect oxygen availability at altitude?
Name one type of oxygen regulator used in aviation.

development.content:
Physiological effects of hypoxia
Need for simple oxygen systems
Pressurized cabin oxygen requirements
Types of oxygen systems
Working principles of components

Types of 02 regulators
Demand regulator operation
Continuous flow regulator operation
Pressure regulator function
Regulator maintenance basics

Comparison of regulator types
Selection criteria for systems
Safety protocols for oxygen use
Troubleshooting common regulator issues
Integration with fire protection systems

summary_questions: Explain why a simple oxygen system is necessary for emergency descent.
Differentiate between demand and continuous flow regulators based on operation.
Describe the effect of lack of oxygen on crew performance at high altitude.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the transition from LP 24 to LP 02, focusing on how fire detection requirements relate to oxygen system safety.

pft_rows.syllabus: Types of fire zone classification of a/c, detection system requirements, types of detection system, types of detectors, extinguishing agents and systems
